Left: mark corner A, corner B (a blue box up to 16×16×16) and, the 3rd time, STEAL the area: the real blocks (with chest and machine contents) leave the world in waves and fly into a point of light to you. Keeps up to 8 heists. Right: menu to pick a heist and place it with a ghost preview (Alt+scroll distance, right rotate, Shift+right mirror, left place). Only fills air, fluids and plants; never takes bedrock or unbreakables.
ability.infinity.space_stone.scene_ancho: Left: drive a blue anchor where you stand and record the scene around it for 10 min (radius 4–12 with Alt+scroll). While anchored, whatever is broken or blown up there drops nothing, and chests resist explosions. Right: a blue wave rebuilds the broken blocks, pops out as items what others placed there and pulls you back to the anchor (same dimension).
ability.infinity.space_stone.fold_distan: Left: space folds and you appear at the aimed point (up to the Alt+scroll distance, 8–96, first safe spot on the line). Players crouching within 3 blocks and your pets come along. Right: folds the aimed target (mob or player, no bosses) to right in front of you.
ability.infinity.space_stone.containment: Left: a translucent blue cube with glowing edges traps the aimed target for 10 s: it cannot leave, projectiles ricochet off the walls and there is no fall damage. Left again: release. Right: drag the cube with its prisoner to where you look (up to 24 blocks). Bosses are immune.
ability.infinity.space_stone.space_mirro: A 4×4 panel of space at the aimed point, facing you, for 20 s. Left: enemy projectiles crossing it fly back to the shooter at twice the speed. Right (return mirror): whatever enters — mob, item, arrow, player — comes out 2 blocks behind you. One per player.
ability.infinity.space_stone.abyss_watch: Left: a holographic panel shows who is on the central End island and on top of the Nether roof (coordinates, distance, how long), how many mobs are there and whom you banished. Right: watch on/off — you get an alert when someone arrives at or leaves those places.
